headline: Public hearings on National Grid pole and underground conduit petitions, and a residential tax exemption for FY 2027.
summary: The agenda includes a vote on a residential tax exemption and five National Grid pole and conduit petitions. It also lists zoning and code changes on motels, inclusionary zoning, and animal control, plus budget transfers of $157,000 and $220,000.
items: Reappointment of Scune Carrington to the Board of Health (440-26)
Reappointment of John Colangeli to the Board of Health (441-26)
Reappointment of Dr. Kunwar Singh to the Board of Health (442-26)
Vote on adopting a residential exemption and minimum residential factor for the FY 2027 tax rate (443-26)
Public hearings on National Grid petitions to install poles and underground conduits on Blaine Street, Hancock Road, Lynn Street, Eastern Avenue, and Broadway (444-26)
Ordinance to change the maximum height for Motel-Hotel uses to 6 stories, not to exceed 75 feet (445-26)
Ordinance to move supervision of the Animal Control Officer in the City Code (446-26)
Ordinance to amend the use regulations in the City Code (327-26)
Ordinance to add an Assistant Department Head Salary Schedule (415-26)
Committee report and ordinance on inclusionary zoning (335-26 and 335A-26)
Finance committee report on a $157,000 transfer from Salary Reserve (427-26)
Finance committee report on a $220,000 transfer from Salary Reserve to Police Salaries (428-26)
Tabled National Grid petition to install a pole on Floral Avenue, with a required hearing (285-26)
location: City Council Chambers, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148

Council will hold public hearings on National Grid petitions to install five new poles and underground conduits

**444-26** 

Petition: Massachusetts Electric Company dba National Grid Plan No. 31286263

· National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Blaine Street beginning at a point approximately 60 feet south of the centerline of the intersection of Lynn Street and Blaine Street, in front of 6 Blaine Street. National Grid to install new midspan pole P5145 50 feet south of pole P2023, Malden, MA.

- · National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Hancock Road

beginning at a point approximately 60 feet east of the centerline of the intersection of Blaine Street and Hancock Road, in front of 24 Blaine Street. National Grid to install new midspan pole P2025-50 60 feet northeast of pole P2025, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install one joint owned pole on Lynn Street beginning at a point approximately 180 feet west of the centerline of the intersection of Lynn Street and Sargent Street, adjacent to the property line of 148 Bellvale Street. National Grid to install new pole P2003 and anchors 30 feet east of P2002 on Lynn Street, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install two joint owned poles on Eastern Avenue. National Grid to install new midspan pole P1977 50 feet west of pole P1978, across the street from 1080 Eastern Avenue, and install new midspan pole P2901 55 feet east of pole P1980, across the street from 1114 Eastern Avenue, Malden, MA.

· National Grid to install underground facilities on Broadway and Eastern Avenue beginning at a point 180 feet north of the centerline of the intersection of Broadway and Eastern Avenue and continuing

- approximately 180 feet south on Broadway and then east onto Eastern

Avenue. National Grid to install a new cable duct bank from existing manhole 2-1 on Broadway to new manhole 2-2 on Eastern Avenue to riser Pole P1979 across the street from 1080 Eastern Avenue, Malden, MA.
